title: Turf War
summary: Lay exactly the paint a turf needs: the area of an ellipse, of a region that crosses the axis, under sine arches, and under a cubic.
subject: mathematics
concepts: Area is positive: the part below the axis adds
Splitting an area at a crossing point
Area under a cubic over symmetric-looking limits
Area with respect to y: ∫ x dy
learningOutcome: The student can find the area under a curve as a definite integral, split it where the curve crosses the axis and add the absolute parts, and use the area of an ellipse, πab.

levels.title: The ellipse turf
levels.adds: Baseline: the area of x²/a² + y²/b² = 1 is πab, four times the first quadrant ∫ b√(1 − x²/a²) dx (Ex 8.1 Q1, Q2; Example 2).
hints: The ellipse is symmetric, so find the area of the first quadrant and multiply by 4.
The turf needs a multiple of π: divide it by a to get b.

levels.title: Across the axis
levels.adds: New: when the curve crosses the x-axis, split the area at the crossing and add the two absolute values (Section 8.2 Remark; Example 3; Misc Q4, Q5).
hints: Find where the line meets the x-axis.
Area below the axis is the integral with the sign taken off.
Add the two areas; do not subtract them.

levels.title: Sine arches
levels.adds: New: every quarter wave of a·sin x has area a, above or below the axis, so n quarter waves give a·n (Example 4; Misc Q3).
hints: One half wave of sin x between 0 and π has area 2.
A quarter wave has area 1 times the height a.
Divide the paint needed by a to count the quarter waves.

levels.title: The cubic lobes
levels.adds: New: for k·x³ from −p to q the lobe below the axis adds to the lobe above it: k(p⁴ + q⁴)/4 (Misc Q4, Q5).
hints: The cubic is negative for x < 0 and positive for x > 0.
Take the absolute value of the integral from −p to 0.
Add k p⁴/4 and k q⁴/4 and match the paint needed.

levels.title: Sideways turf
levels.adds: New: area between x = g(y), the y-axis and y = c, y = d is ∫ g(y) dy; drag the top edge (Ex 8.1 Q4).
hints: Take horizontal strips: each has length x = g(y).
Set the area equal to the target and solve for v.

levels.title: Round turf
levels.adds: New: ∫ √(a² − x²) dx = (x/2)√(a² − x²) + (a²/2) sin⁻¹(x/a); the turf is part of a circle (Ex 7.7 Q1, Q2; Ex 8.1 Q3).
hints: The fence is y = √(a² − x²), a quarter of the circle of radius a.

misconceptions: A definite integral is always the area
The area below the axis is negative
Symmetric limits make the area zero
